recommendation.text: The Board recommends that the Administration either identify all its eligible retirees and their dependents who accumulated after-service health insurance benefits and estimate their after-service health insurance benefits or liabilities as at the date for financial reporting in peacekeeping operations as reported in volume II, or, if not possible, document and formalize the use of the 17 per cent apportionment rate in determining the share of peacekeeping operations in total actual after-service health insurance costs.
